description.value: Free on-demand cable ferry operated by WaterBridge Ferries Inc. under contract to the BC Ministry of Transportation and Transit, crossing Adams Lake about 20 km north of Highway 1 between Chase and Sorrento. Crossing takes about 6 minutes; runs on demand 24 hours a day (3–5 am is emergency service only), no reservation needed. BC's Ministry of Transportation and Transit treats all inland ferries as an extension of the provincial highway system, mandated to accommodate all legal road users, including cyclists — bikes and e-bikes both ride free and unboxed.
